title: Virtual Card Management: Best Practices for Virtual Card Security
summary: This document provides best practices for virtual card security: enable real-time transaction alerts, restrict merchant categories, use one-time cards for untrusted/short-term vendors, and revoke immediately—disabling the card within 3 seconds upon suspected compromise. It also covers routine hygiene (card rotation, no cross-user sharing, secured storage with access controls/audit logs) and a rapid response playbook (revoke, review alerts/transactions, recreate via one-time card, tighten merchant category settings).
